rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING ANTI-DRUG ABUSE COUNCILS IN ALL PROVINCES, CITIES, MUNICIPALITIES, AND BARANGAYS THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY AND PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Creating Anti-drug Abuse Councils In All Provinces, Cities, Municipalities, And Barangays Throughout The Country And Providing Funds Therefor
rows.abstract:
Aims to create mechanisms where a health-based approach on drug addiction can be implemented in the grassroots.
Creates Anti-Drug Abuse Council (ADAC) which shall be composed of local officials and representatives of various community organizations that shall spearhead the planning and implementation, and monitoring of all local anti-drug abuse programs, projects and activities.
Mandates all local government units consisting of provinces, cities, municipalities, and barangays to create or organize their respective ADACs.

rows.title_full: AN ACT FIXING THE SHARE OF THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNIT (LGU) HOSTING GAMING OPERATIONS LICENSED OR OPERATED BY THE PHILIPPINE AMUSEMENT AND GAMING CORPORATION (PAGCOR) IN THE PROCEEDS OF THE FRANCHISE TAX, FURTHER AMENDING SECTION 12 OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 1869, AS AMENDED
rows.title_short: Fixing The Share Of The Local Government Unit ( L G U) Hosting Gaming Operations Licensed Or Operated By The Philippine Amusement And Gaming Corporation ( P A G C O R) In The Proceeds Of The Franchise Tax, Further Amending Section 12 Of Presidential Decree No. 1869, As Amended
rows.abstract:
Mandates that the five percent (5%) franchise tax shall be remitted as follows: three percent (3%) to the National Government and two percent (2%) to the Local Government Unit (LGU) where PAGCOR-operated and licensed gaming operations are located.
Provides that two percent (2%) share shall be paid directly to the LGU concerned.

rows.title_full: AN ACT GOVERNING CIVIL LIABILITY AND COMPENSATION CLAIMS FOR NUCLEAR DAMAGE, REPEALING FOR THE PURPOSE CERTAIN SECTIONS OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 5207, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE “ATOMIC ENERGY REGULATORY AND LIABILITY ACT OF 1968”, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract:
Aims to govern the civil liability and compensation for nuclear damage in case of a nuclear incident occurring in the territory of the Philippines or during carriage of nuclear material for which the operator is liable in accordance with this Act and the relevant international conventions to which the Philippines is a contracting party.
Seeks to ensure that the country has a robust, comprehensive, and effective nuclear liability regime that provides clarity, fairness, and adequate compensation, upholding international best practices, complying with relevant international conventions, fostering cooperation with nuclear technology vendors, and enabling the responsible growth of the country´s nuclear energy program.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2024-03-04, transmitted to the Senate on 2024-03-06 and received by the Senate on 2024-03-06
